notes: Second pass on 9 searches. CDC 'no cure', 'rises sharply after 50', muscle weakness, 'rare' for Ramsay Hunt, review/NICE CG173 claims and NHS England vaccine eligibility ages were not supported by retrieved text and were cut or generalised. Urgent triggers come from NHS inform (Scotland), not nhs.uk via a surgery page; NHS England pharmacy PGD routes eye-area shingles with visual symptoms to A&E, a stricter route than NHS inform, so both are stated. UKHSA and NHS eligibility differ and change; page generalises and defers to NHS/UKHSA. US CDC vaccine ages labelled US. Textbook: 6 first-pass; 4 remain in final (diagnosis from rash x2, 999 x2), one keyFact removed, so published textbook share is under 5%.
